audit.whatIsWrong: Three factual errors: (1) 'Doom marks you the moment you cast anything' — Riot text says Doom marks trigger on enemy DASHES, and Vladimir has none; (2) Shadow Surge called 'point-and-click' — it is a 2000-range missile skillshot (projectile flag) with a recast dash; (3) 'Gloomsong fear' is a fabricated name — the fear comes from Doom 'n Gloom-empowered abilities.
audit.why: enemyKit Riot text: P 'Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark'; R 'Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion. Recast to dash.'
audit.corrected: Dashless-kit interaction stated as an advantage; R described as dodgeable missile; Gloomsong killed.

notes: Packet suspectName on whys[4] 'Shadow Surge' is a false positive — that is Vex's real R name. Fixed three real factual errors: Doom marks trigger on dashes (not ability casts) and Vladimir has none — restated as an advantage; Shadow Surge described as a dodgeable 2000-range missile, not point-and-click; fabricated 'Gloomsong fear' removed. Full-layer sides 0-5 carried blanket 'Skill' disagreeing with content win[] — moved to match (win[] rows already correct, so side edited alone per the chart rule). Packet defect about chart contradicting 54.65% WR: an early-Vex/late-Vlad chart is consistent with a scaling champion's overall WR, so the Vex-early rows were kept. Sweep: breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, ahead, enemyWin remain somewhat templated but I had nothing kit-specific to ground beyond what was already edited elsewhere; recorded here rather than invented.
